findings: 伺う is a humble form associated with 行く／訪ねる and 聞く／尋ねる. The guideline lists 伺う as 謙譲語I and gives the senses 訪ねる・尋ねる・聞く; it does not provide the full set of contexts or every translation in the article.
The verb is especially frequent in professional visits, scheduled appointments, and consultations. The primary source does not measure frequency or register for these contexts.

All four sample sentences and their translations illustrate attested uses. Only the general visit example in the guideline is located; the article’s other sentences are editorial examples without primary-source locators.
